description: A wide 16:9 left-to-right pipeline diagram of how a language model answers one sentence. On the far LEFT a rounded speech box with the text 'How many city e-bike battery packs do we have in Manchester stores?' and above it a small grey label 'Emma asks'. To its right, one large rounded panel filled very light sky blue labelled 'The model' at its top left. Inside that panel, five rounded white boxes in a row joined by right-pointing arrows, each with a small number above it: '2' box 'Tokens' with grey caption 'text cut into pieces'; '3' box 'Vectors' with caption 'each piece becomes numbers'; '4' box 'Attention' with caption 'each piece looks back'; '5' box '24 blocks' with caption 'attention, then MLP, 24 times'; '6' box 'Probabilities' with caption 'one score per token, then a pick'. To the right of the panel, a rounded box labelled 'the next token' with a small number '7' above it. A thick curved arrow loops from 'the next token' back along the TOP of the panel to the 'Tokens' box, labelled '7 · add it, run again'. A thin rounded frame surrounds the whole flow with a small label at its top left '1 · Next-token prediction'. BELOW the model panel, centered, a rounded box filled light green labelled 'Training' with caption 'where the numbers in the blocks come from' and a small number '8' above it, with an upward arrow into the '24 blocks' box. On the bottom RIGHT, a rounded box filled light ember orange labelled 'Ledgerline ERP 7.2' with caption 'Manchester stores: 5,400', with a small number '9' above it, and a dashed grey line between it and the model panel labelled 'no connection yet'. Labels as plain text, no brackets, spelled exactly as given, no other text.
